data.desc: Macricher is a fully integrated, self-managed, self-administered real estate investment trust (REIT). As a leading owner, operator and developer of high-quality retail real estate in densely populated and attractive U.S. markets, Macricher's portfolio is concentrated in California, the Pacific Northwest, Phoenix/Scottsdale and the Metro New York to Washington, D.C., corridor. Developing and managing properties that serve as community cornerstones, Macricher currently owns 39 million square feet of real estate, consisting primarily of interests in 37 retail centers. Macricher is firmly dedicated to advancing environmental goals, social good and sound corporate governance.
